- We can accept a Purchase Order and will invoice on Net 30 terms for this customer once the SOW is signed.
- Invoice delivery: we will send a PDF invoice to ap@acmecloud.com. We can also produce an accompanying CSV export with the columns they requested (invoice_number, date, line_items, net_amount, tax, total). Please confirm the exact CSV column order if theirs differs.

- DocuSign: we can accept a DocuSign-signed SOW. If they prefer Marketplace billing later, we can enable an AWS Marketplace listing but that requires a separate purchase flow and may change invoicing (Marketplace invoices come through AWS).

Next steps (recommended):
1) Marissa/rachel: get Emma to send the signed SOW (DocuSign OK) and the PO number to billing@redwoodinference.com.
2) Emma/AP: provide W-9 and confirm whether ACH or check will be used for payments.
3) Finance: once we receive signed SOW + PO, we will generate invoice PDF and CSV and send to ap@acmecloud.com within 2 business days (Net 30 countdown begins on invoice date).

I have attached a short checklist for AP handoff and our invoice template. Let me know if Acme requires any additional fields on the invoice and we will try to accommodate.
